:::{#exr-matadd-identity-proof}
#### Proving that the zero matrix is the additive identity

@thm-matadd-identity says that adding the [zero matrix](#def-zero-matrix) leaves a [matrix](#def-matrix) unchanged,
just as adding the number $0$ leaves a number unchanged.

Prove @thm-matadd-identity.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Express the $(i, j)$ entry of $\matr{A} + \matr{0}_{m \times n}$ with @def-matrix-addition,
and use that every entry of $\matr{0}_{m \times n}$ is $0$.

:::
